Nucleus Mall ki mega dil se jharkhand sarkar ki chandi, khajane men aae 90 karor | Ranchi | Jharkhand
Ranchi ke charchit Nucleus Mall ki mega dil se jharkhand sarkar ke khajane men karib 90 karor rupye aae hain. is bari proparti dil ki rajistri ke jarie sarkar ko stanp dyuti aur any shulk ke rup men bari rakam mili hai. aakhir Nucleus Mall ki yah dil kitne karor rupye men huee? kiske nam huee rajistri aur jharkhand sarkar ko kaise mila 90 karor ka rajasv? janie is riport men puri jankari.
